a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two clean operate rounds before anyone can take, so roughly a 4% chance either of us survives. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you take as well, the split is random. After that I'll keep operating with you so you can still reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry to leave you exposed. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. Take as soon as it reaches 4.
